sloka: स च प्रमाणं धर्मात्मा राजा लोकगुरुस्तव ।पित्रा दत्तं यथाभागमुपभोक्तुं त्वमर्हसि ॥ २.१०४.२५॥
transliteration: sa ca pramāṇaṁ dharmātmā rājā lokagurustava ।pitrā dattaṁ yathābhāgamupabhoktuṁ tvamarhasi ॥ 2.104.25॥

translations.english: The proclamation of that righteous king revered by the world shall be your guide. You should enjoy that portion bestowed by father.
